overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、收入分配与福利（2 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）。方法上以回归分析、均衡模型为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（5 篇）、arXiv（5 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Proof of a Conjecture of Matherne, Morales, and Selover on Encodings of Unit Interval Orders
papers.abstract: There are two bijections from unit interval orders on $n$ elements to Dyck paths from $(0,0)$ to $(n,n)$. One is to consider the pairs of incomparable elements as forming the set of boxes between a Dyck path and the diagonal. Another is to find a particular part listing (in the sense of Guay-Paquet, Rowland and Morales) which yields an isomorphic poset, and to interpret the part listing as the area sequence of a Dyck path. Matherne, Morales, and Selover conjectured that, for any unit interval order, these two Dyck paths are related by Haglund's well-known zeta bijection. In this paper we prove their conjecture.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】存在两种从包含$n$个元素的单位区间序到从$(0,0)$到$(n,n)$的Dyck路径之间的双射映射。一种方法是将不可比较的元素对视为构成Dyck路径与对角线之间的“盒子”集合；另一种方法是找到一种特定的部分列表（按照Guay-Paquet、Rowland和Morales的定义），该列表能够生成一个同构的偏序集，并将这种部分列表解释为Dyck路径的面积序列。Matherne、Morales和Selover推测，对于任何单位区间序，这两种Dyck路径都通过Haglund著名的zeta双射映射相互关联。在本文中，我们证明了他们的这一猜想。。

papers.title: Local convergence of a proximal type method for weakly convex minimization
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  The main purpose of this paper is to develop and analyze a proximal-type method for the local minimization of weakly convex functions. Our motivation for introducing this algorithm is to increase its versatility and applicability in a broader range of scenarios in optimization and introduce a more adaptable version of the method for typical generalizations. Our study relies heavily on the Moreau envelope, a well-known mathematical tool used to analyze the behavior of the proximal operator. By leveraging the properties of the Moreau envelope, we are able to prove that the proximal algorithm converges in local contexts. Moreover, we present a complexity result to assess the practical feasibility of the proximal algorithm and provide a numerical example to illustrate the practical behavior of the algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
本文的主要目的是开发并分析一种用于弱凸函数局部最小化的近端方法。我们引入这种算法的动机在于提高其在优化问题中的通用性和适用范围，并为典型推广情况提供更具适应性的方法版本。我们的研究大量依赖于莫罗包络（Moreau envelope），这是一种用于分析近端算子行为的著名数学工具。通过利用莫罗包络的性质，我们证明了该近端算法在局部情况下是收敛的。此外，我们还提出了一个复杂性分析结果，以评估该算法的实际可行性，并通过一个数值示例来说明该算法的实际表现。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Discrete Choice under Congestion: Equilibrium and Welfare
papers.abstract: In many choice settings, a rise in aggregate demand for an option lowers an individual's payoff from choosing it. Driving becomes less attractive than taking a train when more commuters drive, clogging the highway. In such cases, a targeted intervention that mitigates the externality at the congested option can divert it elsewhere and also undermine preference based sorting, making overall welfare effects theoretically ambiguous. We develop an empirical framework to analyze such scenarios of endogenous congestion. We show that in these settings, equilibrium exists and is unique without restrictions on functional-form of utilities or dimension/distribution of preference heterogeneity, and even when congestion at one option affects payoffs from other choices. Under a linear-index structure, micro-data on choice enables semiparametric identification of utility contrasts and welfare effects of some, but not all, interventions. We apply the framework to Cambridge undergraduate admissions, where candidates apply through one constituent college, and admission probability depends on application numbers relative to capacity in that college. Using administrative micro-data on 25,325 applicants, we calculate welfare under two counterfactuals: (i) centralized random allocation and (ii) higher rent at popular colleges. Random allocation reduces welfare for everyone: it removes individual choice without improving admission chances since, by design, lower congestion at a college exactly counterbalances the lower probability of being allocated there. Targeted rent increase produces both gains and losses, with median loss for men and median gain for women. This exercise shows how identified preferences and equilibrium feedback jointly determine welfare when choices entail externalities.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】在许多选择情境中，对某种选项的总需求增加会降低个人选择该选项所获得的收益。当更多通勤者选择开车出行时，驾车出行相较于乘坐火车变得不那么具有吸引力，从而导致高速公路拥堵。在这种情况下，针对拥堵问题的干预措施可以将交通压力转移到其他地方，同时也会削弱基于个人偏好的资源分配机制，从而使整体福利效应在理论上变得难以确定。我们构建了一个实证框架来分析这类内生性拥堵现象。研究表明，在这些情境下，均衡是存在的且是唯一的，无论效用函数的形式或偏好异质性的维度/分布如何；即使某个选项的拥堵状况影响了其他选择的收益，均衡依然成立。在采用线性指数结构的模型中，关于选择的微观数据能够使我们半参数地识别某些干预措施的效用差异及其福利效应，但并非所有干预措施都能被准确评估。我们将该框架应用于剑桥大学的本科生招生过程：候选人通过该校的一个学院进行申请，录取概率取决于申请人数与该学院招生能力的比值。利用25,325名申请者的行政数据，我们模拟了两种反事实情景：（1）集中随机分配；（2）热门学院的学费上涨。结果显示，随机分配机制会降低所有人的福利——虽然它消除了个人的选择自由，但并未提高录取机会，因为这种分配方式...。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Unobserved Consideration and Consumer Welfare
papers.abstract: Can welfare effects of price change be identified when consumers' consideration sets are heterogeneous and unobserved? We establish that the welfare distribution is the same functional of structural choice probabilities under stable but limited consideration as under full consideration. The result permits unrestricted income-effects, preference heterogeneity, and dependence between preferences and consideration. Within this class, limited consideration admits a full-consideration representation preserving choice-probabilities and money-metric compensation: consideration/preferences can remain unidentified while demand and welfare are identified. When consideration sets contract as prices rise, the welfare distribution can be bounded using demand and a bound on choice-set attrition.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】当消费者的考虑集具有异质性且无法观测时，我们能否识别价格变动所带来的福利效应？我们发现，在考虑范围有限但稳定的情况下，福利分布与在完全考虑所有选项的情况下所遵循的函数关系是相同的。这一结果允许存在不受限制的收入效应、偏好异质性，以及偏好与考虑范围之间的关联性。在这一类情况下，即使考虑范围有限，仍然可以通过保持选择概率和货币度量补偿的方式来构建完全考虑情况下的福利分布模型：即使无法确定消费者的具体考虑范围和偏好，需求与福利水平仍然是可以识别的。当价格上涨导致消费者的考虑范围缩小时，可以通过需求数据以及对考虑范围缩减程度的限制来界定福利分布的范围。。

papers.title: Does Institutional Quality Determine Environmental Sustainability?
papers.abstract: Environmental sustainability increasingly depends on the alignment between development strategies and institutional governance, yet empirical evidence on the role of institutional quality in shaping environmental degradation remains highly contested. While institutions are widely theorised as central to environmental governance, existing studies report mixed and sometimes contradictory findings. This study addresses this ambiguity through a comprehensive meta‐analysis of 792 effect sizes drawn from 134 empirical studies examining the relationship between institutional quality and environmental degradation. Using random‐effects models, multilevel mixed‐effects models, and Bayesian model averaging, the analysis evaluates the average association between institutional quality and environmental degradation while explicitly accounting for heterogeneity, study dependence and publication bias. The results indicate that, on average, stronger institutional quality is associated with lower environmental degradation, though this relationship is highly conditional. Subgroup analyses show that World Governance and Political Risk indices yield more robust negative associations than narrower or compositionally heterogeneous measures and that effects are stronger for ecological footprint than carbon emissions. Meta‐regression identifies infrastructure, technology, globalisation, foreign direct investment and regional context as key moderators. The findings suggest institutional quality functions as a conditioning framework rather than a uniform determinant of environmental outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】环境可持续性在很大程度上取决于发展战略与制度治理之间的协调性。然而，关于制度质量在环境退化过程中所起作用的实证证据仍存在较大争议。尽管制度通常被视为环境治理的核心要素，但现有研究的结果却呈现出复杂且有时相互矛盾的现象。本研究通过对134项实证研究中得出的792个效应量进行综合元分析，试图澄清这一模糊性。通过运用随机效应模型、多层次混合效应模型以及贝叶斯模型平均法，该分析在充分考虑异质性、研究依赖性和发表偏倚的情况下，评估了制度质量与环境退化之间的平均关联程度。研究结果表明，总体而言，较高的制度质量与较低的环境退化程度相关，但这种关联具有很强的条件性。 subgroup 分析显示，世界治理指数和政治风险指数所揭示的负相关关系更为稳健；此外，生态足迹指标的影响强度高于碳排放指标。元回归分析进一步指出，基础设施、技术水平、全球化进程、外国直接投资以及地区背景是影响这种关联的关键调节因素。这些发现表明，制度质量更多地起到一种调节作用，而非决定环境结果的唯一因素。。研究方法：回归分析、贝叶斯方法。

papers.title: Applying the COPRAS Method for Stock Price Prediction: A Comparative Analysis of Selected Companies
papers.abstract: This paper explores the application in advanced algorithms and methodologies Stock price forecasting is extremely important as it has a significant financial impact, influencing investment decisions and market strategies accurate market forecasting. Effective predictive models offer benefits beyond wealth creation, including early identification of failing investments to prevent market disruptions. The study acknowledges the inherent challenges in financial time series analysis—non-stationarity, nonlinearity, and high volatility—which necessitate continued development of more sophisticated analytical approaches. The research examines both internal factors (company profits, liabilities, competition) and external factors (oil prices, exchange rates, political stability) that influence stock prices. Traditional stock trend prediction algorithms rely on historical time series data, while newer approaches incorporate AI and Machine learning methods, including artificial neural networks (ANNs), are important in advanced predictive modeling and have shown better performance than traditional regression methods, though significant challenges remain in optimizing input variables and network architecture. The paper particularly highlights the promising performance The study uses Machine learning and deep learning approaches, particularly the use of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), are used to predict final prices. which outperform other methods. In addition, the research introduces a novel approach stock price prediction model, built on the basis of Dragonfly Algorithm (DFA)-optimized Deep Belief Network (DBN), which leverages market Sentiment analysis from social media data. For evaluation, this study uses the Complex Proportionality Assessment (COPRAS) method along with other multi-criteria decision-making methods (MCDM) methods, such as the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP), are used in decision-making processes analysis. These methods help assess and rank different prediction models based on multiple criteria, providing a robust framework for addressing complex financial forecasting challenges. The integrated approach combining statistical methods with machine learning techniques based on technical analysis offers valuable insights for investors, particularly those focused on short-term investments. This research contributes to ongoing efforts to develop more accurate forecasting models, though acknowledges that no universal solution has yet been established.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文探讨了高级算法和方法在股票价格预测中的应用。股票价格预测具有重要意义，因为它对金融领域具有重大影响，能够影响投资决策和市场策略。准确的预测模型不仅有助于财富创造，还能提前识别出表现不佳的投资项目，从而避免市场波动。研究指出了金融时间序列分析中存在的固有挑战——非平稳性、非线性和高波动性——这些挑战要求不断开发更为复杂的分析方法。研究分析了影响股票价格的内部因素（公司利润、负债、竞争状况）和外部因素（油价、汇率、政治稳定性）。传统的股票趋势预测算法依赖于历史时间序列数据，而新兴的方法则结合了人工智能和机器学习技术，其中人工神经网络（ANN）在高级预测建模中表现出色，其性能优于传统的回归方法，尽管在优化输入变量和网络架构方面仍存在挑战。本文特别强调了生成对抗网络（GAN）在股票价格预测中的优异表现。此外，研究还提出了一种基于龙fly算法（DFA）优化的深度信念网络（DBN）的新型股票价格预测模型，该模型利用了社交媒体数据中的市场情绪分析。在评估过程中，本研究采用了复杂比例评估（COPRAS）方法以及其他多标准决策方法（如层次分析法AHP），这些方法有助于根据多种标准对不同的预测模...。研究方法：时间序列、回归分析、机器学习、深度学习、神经网络、情绪分析。

papers.title: Gender, immigration and entrepreneurship
papers.abstract:
Purpose
                    This study examines how the intersection of gender and immigration affects women's entrepreneurial engagement, empowering them to achieve financial independence and autonomy. Grounded in intersectionality and role congruity theory, it explores how national gender inequality influences the relationship between gender, immigration and the pursuit of entrepreneurship.
                  
                  
                    Design/methodology/approach
                    Our cross-sectional analysis utilizes data from 63 countries and 272,910 individuals. We employ logistic regression analysis along with robust checks such as propensity score matching, probit regression and the entropy balancing technique.
                  
                  
                    Findings
                    The findings highlight the compound challenges faced by immigrant women in entrepreneurship and the influence of national gender inequality on women's entrepreneurial pursuits. Our investigation reveals that women generally face discouragement from pursuing entrepreneurship. Immigrant women face more disadvantages in pursuing entrepreneurship compared with male immigrants and male natives. Notably, our results suggest that the negative relationship between being a woman and entrepreneurial activity is weaker in countries with higher levels of gender inequality.
                  
                  
                    Social implications
                    It suggests that policy adjustments promoting entrepreneurship in contexts with varying levels of gender equality could foster sustainable development among both native and immigrant populations.
                  
                  
                    Originality/value
                    The study contributes to the literature by (1) revealing the compounded challenges women immigrants face in entrepreneurship and (2) highlighting how national gender inequality affects women's entrepreneurial pursuits.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**研究目的**  
本研究探讨了性别与移民身份的交叉如何影响女性的创业参与度，从而帮助她们实现经济独立和自主。基于交叉性理论（intersectionality）和角色一致性理论（role congruity theory），本研究分析了国家层面的性别不平等如何影响性别、移民身份与创业行为之间的关系。  

**研究设计/方法**  
我们的横断面分析使用了来自63个国家、共计272,910名受访者的数据。研究方法包括逻辑回归分析（logistic regression），并采用了倾向得分匹配（propensity score matching）、Probit回归（probit regression）以及熵平衡技术（entropy balancing technique）等稳健性检验方法。  

**研究结果**  
研究结果表明，移民女性在创业过程中面临多重挑战，且国家层面的性别不平等对她们的事业发展产生了显著影响。总体而言，女性在创业过程中更容易受到阻碍；与男性移民及本土男性相比，移民女性在创业方面处于更为不利的地位。值得注意的是，在性别不平等程度较高的国家中，女性身份与创...。研究方法：倾向得分匹配、横截面分析、回归分析。

papers.title: Evaluating the Geometric Brownian Motion Model for Gold Price Movements (XAU/USD) across Market Conditions
papers.venue: Analitika Journal of Economics Management and Business
papers.abstract: This study evaluates the performance of the Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM) model in predicting prices and estimating the risk of XAU/USD under stable and unstable economic conditions. Daily closing price data are divided into in-sample and out-of-sample periods, where return and volatility parameters are estimated from the in-sample data and applied in Monte Carlo simulations. Prediction accuracy is assessed using the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), while risk is measured using Value at Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES). The results indicate that MAPE values exceed 20% in both economic conditions, suggesting that the predictive accuracy of the GBM model remains moderate. Although the model performs slightly better during stable periods, the difference is not statistically significant. In contrast, risk estimation results show that VaR and ES range between 58% and 59%, with higher values observed during unstable periods. This reflects an increase in market risk driven by higher volatility. Overall, the findings suggest that while GBM is capable of capturing the general movement of gold prices, it has limitations in accurately predicting price levels and capturing extreme market fluctuations, particularly during periods of economic instability.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本研究评估了几何布朗运动（GBM）模型在稳定和经济不稳定两种条件下预测黄金价格（XAU/USD）以及评估相关风险的表现。每日收盘价数据被划分为样本内和样本外两个时期，其中回报率和波动率参数是根据样本内数据估算得出的，并用于蒙特卡洛模拟中。预测准确性通过平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）来衡量，而风险则通过风险价值（VaR）和预期亏损（ES）来评估。研究结果表明，在两种经济条件下，MAPE值均超过了20%，这表明GBM模型的预测准确性处于中等水平。尽管该模型在稳定时期表现略好，但这种差异并不具有统计学意义。相比之下，风险估算结果显示，VaR和ES的值介于58%至59%之间，且在经济不稳定时期风险值更高。这反映了市场风险因波动率上升而增加。总体而言，研究结果表明，虽然GBM模型能够捕捉到黄金价格的一般走势，但在准确预测价格水平以及捕捉极端市场波动方面存在局限性，尤其是在经济不稳定时期。。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟。

papers.title: When expertise fails: detection of artificial intelligence - generated vitiligo imagery across the spectrum of dermatological experience; a cross-sectional exploratory study
papers.venue: Visual Computing for Industry Biomedicine and Art
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Generative artificial intelligence (AI) can produce highly realistic dermatological images, raising concerns about clinicians’ ability to distinguish authentic pathology from synthetic representations. To assess whether dermatological expertise influences the detection of AI-generated vitiligo images, and to evaluate the self-detection capabilities of the algorithm, we conducted a participant-blinded cross-sectional study in which 31 dermatologists, stratified by experience, classified one AI-generated vitiligo image alongside three real controls while blinded to the number and identity of the synthetic images. Interrater agreement was assessed using Fleiss’ kappa statistic, and the synthetic image was additionally evaluated using three large multimodal models. Residents detected the AI-generated image more frequently than senior dermatologists and key opinion leaders. After disclosure of the correct classifications, the experts identified specific biological inconsistencies, whereas residents relied primarily on intuitive impressions, and the performance of the AI models varied across the detection and post-disclosure artifact-recognition tasks. This study is limited by its evaluation of a single AI-generated image depicting a single disease (vitiligo), and the findings may therefore not be generalizable to other dermatological morphologies, image-generation prompts, or multi-image scenarios. In this exploratory study, greater clinical experience was associated with reduced detection of the evaluated synthetic image; whether this reflects a general effect of expertise requires further study. These findings highlight the emerging risks associated with medical AI and support the integration of AI-focused visual analysis into dermatology education.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
生成式人工智能（AI）能够生成高度逼真的皮肤科图像，这引发了人们对临床医生区分真实病理情况与合成图像能力的担忧。为了评估皮肤科专业技能是否会影响AI生成的白癜风图像的识别能力，并检验该算法的自我识别能力，我们进行了一项参与者盲法横断面研究。研究中，31名皮肤科医生根据经验水平被分组，他们在不知合成图像数量和具体身份的情况下，将一张AI生成的白癜风图像与三张真实对照图像进行分类。评估者间的一致性通过Fleiss’ kappa统计量进行衡量；同时，这些合成图像还接受了三种大型多模态模型的分析。结果发现，住院医师比资深皮肤科医生和行业专家更频繁地识别出AI生成的图像。在得知正确分类结果后，专家们指出了图像中的生物学异常特征，而住院医师主要依赖直觉进行判断；此外，AI模型在图像识别任务和识别后的异常图像识别任务中的表现存在差异。本研究的局限性在于仅评估了单一疾病（白癜风）的AI生成图像，因此其结论可能不适用于其他皮肤科病变类型、图像生成方式或多张图像的场景。这项探索性研究表明，更丰富的临床经验与对合成图像的识别率降低有关；这一现象是否反映了专业技能的普遍影响，还需进一步研究。这...。研究方法：横截面分析。

papers.title: Designing Public Information for Strategic Advice
papers.abstract: A principal chooses an action using advice from an expert who privately knows local conditions. Before receiving advice, she can commission a public study of an independent state, such as future demand, that changes the expected conflict between their preferred actions. We show that the communication protocol determines the optimal study. Under optimal mediation, the value of advice is convex in conflict, making full revelation optimal. Under commitment to an action rule, the principal may prefer no information, while informative optimal studies include a report certifying high conflict. Under unmediated cheap talk, changes in the number of equilibrium messages create upward kinks in the value of advice. Optimal studies avoid interior communication thresholds and can induce two distant communication regimes while skipping every regime in between, strictly outperforming both full revelation and no information. When the principal retains the raw data, selective public disclosure can improve advice without sacrificing forecasting precision. We discuss implications for fiscal forecasts and spending agencies.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】一位负责人在专家的建议下做出决策，该专家私下了解当地实际情况。在收到建议之前，她可以委托对某个独立状态（如未来需求）进行公开研究，这种研究会改变她们所倾向的不同决策方案之间的预期冲突。我们发现，沟通机制决定了最佳的研究内容。在最佳中介机制下，建议的价值与冲突程度呈正相关，因此完全披露信息是最优选择。当负责人必须遵循某种行动规则时，她可能更倾向于不获取任何信息；而具有信息价值的研究则会出具证明冲突程度较高的报告。在缺乏中介机制且信息传播成本较低的情况下，均衡信息数量的变化会导致建议价值的非线性波动（即出现“向上突变”）。最佳的研究方案能够避免某些沟通障碍，从而实现两种截然不同的沟通模式，并且能够跳过所有中间模式，其效果明显优于完全披露信息或完全不披露信息的情况。当负责人保留原始数据时，选择性公开部分信息可以在不牺牲预测准确性的前提下提升建议的质量。我们还讨论了这一发现对财政预测和支出机构可能产生的影响。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Stay, Reposition, or Recharge: Battery-Aware Operation of Robotaxi Fleets
papers.abstract: Electric robotaxis are rapidly expanding from pilots to scaled commercial deployment; unlike traditional human-driven ride-hailing vehicles, they require centralized fleet control and careful management of vehicle state of charge (SoC). We study how a fleet manager should jointly make service, empty repositioning, idling, and charging decisions in such systems. We develop a continuous-time fluid model in which vehicles evolve across location-charge states, and identify two forms of charge-aware control that are absent from classic repositioning models: early return-to-depot (RTD) and charge-aware repositioning. In particular, the optimal solution admits simple threshold structures. Each location has a battery threshold such that vehicles should return to the depot to recharge when their SoC is below it and should not do so when their SoC is above it. Vehicles should not reposition below the same threshold either; above it, the choice of destination depends on whether a vehicle's SoC matches the destination's battery sensitivity, a notion we introduce in the paper. We then quantify the value of charge awareness by comparing fully charge-aware policies with charge-oblivious policies that ignore SoC in RTD and repositioning decisions. We show that the performance gap can be unbounded, driven by a dilemma between under-utilizing high-charge vehicles and over-sending low-charge vehicles to locations from which charging is costly. A numerical case study calibrated using 2025 NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission trip records illustrates these thresholds and shows that charge-aware control can generate substantial gains in a realistic urban network. Importantly, simple threshold-based heuristics recover most of the value of the fully charge-aware solution.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】电动机器人出租车正从试点项目迅速发展为大规模的商业应用。与传统的人工驾驶网约车不同，这类车辆需要集中式的车队管理以及对车辆电池电量（SoC）的精细控制。我们研究了车队管理者应如何在这些系统中协同制定服务调度、空车回程调度、车辆怠速运行以及充电等决策。我们建立了一个连续时间流体模型，用于描述车辆在不同位置和电量状态下的动态变化，并发现了经典车辆调度模型中缺失的两种基于电量信息的控制策略：提前返回充电站（RTD）和基于电量信息的重新调度策略。特别地，最优解决方案采用了简单的阈值机制——当车辆电量低于某个阈值时，应返回充电站进行充电；当电量高于该阈值时，则无需返回。此外，车辆也不应在电量低于同一阈值的情况下进行重新调度；而在电量高于该阈值时，行驶目的地的选择取决于车辆的电量是否与目的地的电池电量需求相匹配（这一概念在论文中有所阐述）。我们通过比较完全基于电量信息的调度策略与忽略电量信息的调度策略（即在RTD和重新调度决策中不考虑电量因素的策略），量化了电量信息的重要性。研究发现，由于存在高电量车辆利用率不足以及低电量车辆被过度派遣到充电成本较高的地点之间的权衡，两者之间的性能差距可能非...。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Willingness-to-pay space and preference space: a unified treatment of equivalence, heterogeneity and interpretation
papers.abstract: A growing number of choice modelling studies estimate their models "in willingness-to-pay (WTP) space", yet often treat this as a different model that fits better (or worse) than "preference space", and misread what its parameters represent. This note brings together and makes precise insights that have mostly been stated only in scattered places, organising them around a single condition for two specifications to be the same model. WTP space is a reparameterisation, and with non-random coefficients the two spaces give identical likelihoods, WTP estimates and standard errors. With deterministic heterogeneity in cost sensitivity, or non-linearity, WTP must still be computed as a ratio of partial derivatives, although a simple normalisation recovers a directly estimated WTP at a reference point. With random heterogeneity, latent class models are equivalent in the two spaces, while other mixtures are equivalent only when the implied distributions match, as with full-covariance lognormals, and independence is not a neutral assumption.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】越来越多的选择建模研究选择在“支付意愿（WTP）空间”中对模型进行估计，但这些研究往往将WTP空间视为与“偏好空间”不同的模型，并误读了其参数所代表的含义。本文汇总了这些研究中的观点，并对它们进行了系统的分析，主要基于一个关键条件：即两种模型规格必须相同。实际上，WTP空间只是对原始模型的重新参数化表达；当系数非随机时，这两种模型在似然值、WTP估计值及标准误差方面是完全一致的。在成本敏感性存在确定性异质性或非线性的情况下，WTP仍需通过偏导数的比值来计算；不过通过简单的标准化处理，仍可以在参考点处得到直接估计的WTP值。对于随机异质性情况，潜在类别模型在这两个空间中是等价的；而其他混合模型只有在其隐含分布相匹配时才具有等价性（例如全协方差对数正态分布模型）。此外，模型中的独立性并非一个中性的假设。。
